request.prompt: Calm armored male sword assassin, loopable idle in a low half-turned guard. Left foot forward, knees bent, hips low and steady. Right hand grips a long sword low beside the right thigh, blade angled forward and down, wrist firm. Slow breathing, tiny weight shift between feet. Head turns first, left shoulder and open left hand follow; left fingers flex lightly. Feet planted. Ends in start pose.

Armored male sword assassin walking forward in a low crouched stance, steady pace, loopable cycle. Hips stay low, knees bent, quick short steps, feet recovered close to the ground. Upper body calm and quiet, slight forward lean. Right hand holds a long sword low at the right side, blade pointing back and down, away from the legs. Left arm swings a little. Even rhythm, no turning.

Armored male sword assassin sprinting forward fast with a deep forward lean and low hips, loopable cycle. Quick light strides, feet skimming close to the ground. Right hand grips a long sword trailing behind and down, arm extended back, blade swept away from the legs. Left arm pumps compactly near the chest. Head level, eyes forward. Steady rhythm, no turning.

Armored male sword assassin, long sword in right hand, three fast basic attacks from a low guard. One: small coil, step in, diagonal slash from right shoulder down to left hip. Two: hips twist, quick horizontal backhand slash left to right. Three: brief crouch, rising diagonal slash with the whole body. After each cut the torso stops the blade and he settles into a low guard. Feet end near start.

Armored male sword assassin, long sword in right hand. From a low stance he whirls the sword in one full horizontal circle around his body at waist height, torso turning with it, then flings both arms wide open outward in a sharp release, as if launching blades in all directions. Short hold, then returns to a low guard. Feet planted, no travel.

Armored male sword assassin, long sword in right hand. Explosive forward dash: drops into a deep forward lean, sword pulled back low behind the right hip, covers about three meters in a few long low strides, then plants the front foot and stops in a crouched ready stance with the sword cocked back for the next slash. Holds the ready stance.

Armored male sword assassin, long sword in right hand. Rushes forward in a deep low lean, arrives with a rising upward slash, then two quick light slashes, right to left and left to right, then a big full body overhead finishing slash straight down with a deep lunge. Holds the low finish briefly, then rises back to a low guard. Clear rhythm: slash, slash, slash, finisher.

Armored male swordsman in a calm, slightly lowered ready stance, loopable idle. Feet shoulder width, left foot half a step forward, knees softly bent, back straight, not squatting. Right hand holds a long sword low and forward at hip height, arm relaxed. Left hand open near the left hip, fingers flexing slightly. Slow breathing, small weight shift, head glances aside. Ends in start pose.

Armored male swordsman walking straight forward in a line at a steady pace, never turning. Slightly lowered hips, knees bent, short quick steps with feet low to the ground, heel to toe. Torso calm and upright with a slight forward lean. Right hand holds a long sword low at the right side, blade pointing back. Left arm swings gently. Even steps, loopable cycle.
